prompt:
Use case: image edit
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC neutral thinking-eye atlas
Input images: Image 1 is the exact source grid. Preserve this NPC's identity, neutral brow and original eye anatomy.
Composition: One exact 2×2 pixel-art atlas on a 64:35 canvas; each cell is 64×35 native pixels. Top-left: image-left gaze, open eyes. Top-right: image-right gaze, open eyes. Bottom-left: image-left gaze, half blink. Bottom-right: image-right gaze, half blink.
Constraints: Preserve the exact source lid contours and narrow aperture, compact iris/pupil size and actual source iris hue, neutral brow, face, skin palette, shading, hair and exterior. Make only a gentle approximately one-native-pixel horizontal gaze shift. Keep pupils inside each eye. Use very restrained highlights matching the source. Maintain continuous, natural lids in half-blink cells. No wider eye opening, broad white bands, bright sclera flashes, changed iris color, vertical/diagonal movement, new makeup, added details, text or borders. Keep all cell boundaries aligned.
